title: Land secured for South Auckland hospital
summary: Land has been secured for a future hospital facility on Karaka Road in Drury, marking a significant investment in the long-term healthcare needs of South Auckland's growing population.

title: Pharmacies to provide more funded medicines
summary: Pharmac and Health New Zealand are increasing the number of funded medicines community pharmacies can provide from today, Associate Health Minister David Seymour and Health Minister Simeon Brown say.

title: Government progresses plan changes to enable growth for New Plymouth
summary: Targeted changes to New Plymouth’s District Plan will make it easier for homeowners and developers to build, alter homes, and make better use of land, while removing unnecessary consenting requirements and other planning barriers to growth.

title: Next steps for Nelson Tasman weather radar
summary: Nelson Tasman communities are one step closer to more timely and accurate weather information, with a site selected for the region’s new weather radar.

title: Beekeepers get more certainty on American foulbrood management
summary: The Government is progressing long-signalled updates to the National American Foulbrood Pest Management Plan, based on proposals developed and consulted on by the beekeeping industry.
